introduction_text:
Nikki Cash Ledger

Log any cash transaction here. Finance will review and approve your entries.

  • Date — the date the cash was received or paid out
  • Entity — which business the transaction belongs to
  • Transaction Type — select the closest category
  • Direction — Cash In if you received money, Cash Out if you paid out
  • Amount — the dollar amount (no negatives)
  • Invoice # — reference number if applicable
  • Notes — any additional details
  • Receipt — attach a photo or PDF of the receipt
